description: Meta Ad Library API: Search Google ads. Ads (creatives) shown on Google Search, YouTube, Display and Shopping by one advertiser or for one website domain, with format, region and date filters, up to 40 per call. Each ad has its first and last shown dates, image creatives and a `preview_url` that renders it. Price: 5 credits per call; failed calls are free. Paginated: pass pagination.next_cursor as `cursor` for the next page (each page is a new call). One of advertiser_id, domain is required.

active_from.description: Shown on or after (YYYY-MM-DD; the source filters dates over about the last year)

advertiser_id.description: Advertiser ID from Search Google advertisers (required unless `domain` is set)

domain.description: Website domain the ads point to (required unless `advertiser_id` is set)

limit.description: Ads per page (max 40, one page of the source)

region.description: Two-letter country code where the ads were shown, or `ALL`

name: ads_google_ads_search
title: Search Google ads
